sources.location: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.nbd.2025.107207 (PMID 41319756; not open access, not read)

claims.value: Run-name token <id><D|T><H|N> -> treatment and brain region.
claims.evidence: Sample_grouping.txt defines TH/DH/TN/DN as TAT control / DJNKI-1 in hippocampus / nucleus accumbens.

claims.value: LTQ Orbitrap XL DDA; trypsin; fixed Carbamidomethyl; variable Oxidation M, Protein N-term Acetyl, Phospho STY; MS/MS tol 0.5 Da.
claims.evidence: Instrument and enzyme from the sample-processing protocol; modifications from the data-processing protocol; ITMS MS/MS tolerance from parameters.txt.

limitations: Paper is not open access; strain, sex, age/stage of the mice and doses are not stated in the deposit and are `not available`.

Run-name numbers are not unique animal IDs (e.g. 4DH and 4TH both exist); biological replicate is the order within each treatment x region group. Same-number repeat runs (6TN, 12DN) are technical replicates.
Precursor tolerance and dissociation method are not stated in the deposit (parameters.txt gives no main-search ppm); recorded as `not available`.
Gel-slice fractionation is described but only one RAW per sample is deposited, so no fraction columns.
